headline: Northern and Central Fronts Re-ignite as Heavy Clashes Grip Sector Outposts
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, frontline instability has reignited across the northern and central theaters, marked by sharp tactical turnover in Weathered Expanse and renewed fighting in Linn of Mercy. Weathered Expanse logged eight base transitions over the past two hours around Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest, while Linn of Mercy matched that pace with eight fresh events at Outwich Ranch and Lathair. Palantine Berm continues its ferocious see-saw battle, recording nine base changes across Vendett and Windburn Landing amidst steady mutual casualties. In Stlican Shelf, active base exchanges paused over the two-hour window, yet bloodletting surged to over fourteen hundred combined casualties. A severe escalation also gripped Nevish Line, where casualty rates surged past fifteen hundred in two hours despite frozen territory lines. Meanwhile, Stonecradle registered further friction at The Dais, and Godcrofts saw fresh contesting at Isawa, keeping both commands stretched across active contested borders.
